properties.name: Maze: Spanish Bottom loop, May 2026
properties.readme:
Five days: a jet boat to Spanish Bottom, a loop west into the Maze, and back down to the river. The routes are GPS recordings, not plans. Times are local (MDT).

Camps were at-large. A camp is named for a trail only where its recording ended within 20 m of one. Route names are matched from the recordings to OpenStreetMap trail names.

days.notes: Jet boat drop-off at Spanish Bottom on the Colorado River. Climbed the Spanish Bottom Trail to the Doll House (10:22 am to 12:45 pm), then walked north to camp 1 (1:20 to 7:34 pm).
West into the Maze canyons to camp 2 (9:52 am to 7:33 pm). Evening walk from camp, 9:15 to 10:25 pm, looking for a spring. Didn't find it; low on water.
Layover at camp 2. Day hike out the Maze Overlook Trail and back to camp, 12:26 to 4:06 pm.
Back along Pete's Mesa Route toward the Doll House, then to camp 3 (9:59 am to 3:47 pm).
Down to Spanish Bottom (7:43 to 8:54 am). Jet boat pickup.
